recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a separate Observation.status code for not-asked unless OO makes a new decision; the current status definition and v2 mapping guidance are consistent with the applied FHIR-33043 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-33043 asked whether HL7 v2 OBX-11 not asked should be clarified as part of Observation.status=final or represented by a separate status. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to clarify that not asked is a form of final status with dataAbsentReason not-asked.
initial_application: Commit 3eb925d9fb58c5c201d2477f024d90ebe8029bca updated source/observation/codesystem-observation-status.xml to add the not-asked dataAbsentReason sentence to the final status definition. Jira later referenced merge commit 55f6bd5d2f78d1b06573faad4ad1474595a2db60 as added to the build. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit for FHIR-33043 existed on the combined branch.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Observation code system and StructureDefinition sources are in current build scope. The current combined branch retains the final/not-asked clarification, and later Applied issue FHIR-50536 updated the Observation v2 mappings so dataAbsentReason.code not-asked also maps to OBX-11=N. Later not-performed/cancelled Observation guidance in FHIR-51640 and the FHIR-46579 cleanup of a different superseded status code do not reverse or narrow this rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the latest combined-branch source already satisfies the seed issue and no necessary semantic correction remains.
